parameters.query: SELECT b.id AS branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, b.open_time, b.close_time, b.lunch_start_time, b.lunch_duration, b.break1_time, b.break1_duration, b.break2_time, b.break2_duration, b.break3_time, b.break3_duration, b.open_time_weekend, b.close_time_weekend, b.confirmation_hours, b.service_days, w.id AS workshop_id, TRIM(w.google_calendar_url) AS calendar_id, w.mails, (LOWER(IFNULL(w.name, '')) LIKE '%lavad%') AS is_lavado, COALESCE((SELECT ot.wash_minutes FROM operation_times ot WHERE ot.client_id = b.client_id AND ot.branch_id = b.id ORDER BY ot.id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT ot.wash_minutes FROM operation_times ot WHERE ot.client_id = b.client_id AND ot.branch_id IS NULL ORDER BY ot.id DESC LIMIT 1), 30) AS wash_minutes FROM branches b JOIN workshops w ON w.branch_id = b.id AND w.is_active = 1 AND w.business_type = 'service' AND w.google_calendar_url IS NOT NULL AND w.google_calendar_url <> '' WHERE b.client_id = $1 AND b.is_active = 1 AND b.has_wash = 1 AND (UPPER(b.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', $2, '%') OR UPPER(b.city) LIKE CONCAT('%', $3, '%')) ORDER BY w.id

SELECT b.id AS branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, b.open_time, b.close_time, b.lunch_start_time, b.lunch_duration, b.break1_time, b.break1_duration, b.break2_time, b.break2_duration, b.break3_time, b.break3_duration, b.open_time_weekend, b.close_time_weekend, b.confirmation_hours, b.service_days, w.id AS workshop_id, TRIM(w.google_calendar_url) AS calendar_id, w.mails, (LOWER(IFNULL(w.name, '')) LIKE '%lavad%') AS is_lavado, COALESCE((SELECT ot.wash_minutes FROM operation_times ot WHERE ot.client_id = b.client_id AND ot.branch_id = b.id ORDER BY ot.id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT ot.wash_minutes FROM operation_times ot WHERE ot.client_id = b.client_id AND ot.branch_id IS NULL ORDER BY ot.id DESC LIMIT 1), 30) AS wash_minutes FROM branches b JOIN workshops w ON w.branch_id = b.id AND w.is_active = 1 AND w.business_type = 'service' AND w.google_calendar_url IS NOT NULL AND w.google_calendar_url <> '' WHERE b.client_id = $1 AND b.is_active = 1 AND b.has_wash = 1 ORDER BY b.id, w.id

additionalFields.description: ={{ ['Turno de lavado (IA WhatsApp)', 'Tipo de lavado: ' + ($('Validar').first().json.tipo_lavado || 'SIN INFORMAR'), 'Nombre: ' + $('Validar').first().json.nombre, 'Teléfono: ' + $('Validar').first().json.telefono, 'Email: ' + ($('Validar').first().json.email || 'SIN INFORMAR'), 'Patente: ' + $('Validar').first().json.patente, 'Modelo: ' + $('Validar').first().json.modelo, 'Kilometraje: ' + ($('Validar').first().json.km || 'SIN INFORMAR'), 'Contacto preferido: ' + ($('Validar').first().json.contacto || 'SIN INFORMAR'), 'Sucursal: ' + $json.branch_name, 'Agendado: ' + $now.setZone('America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires').toFormat('dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')].join(String.fromCharCode(10)) }}
